reasons: eurusd-patterns: FX research configuration or evidence is incomplete (InvalidOperationException).
FX market-data streams are missing or unhealthy.
Fresh paired FX bid/ask is unavailable; MIDPOINT history cannot replace quote ticks.
FX session is closed; collection will resume independently of trading permission.
Readiness: history=False; research=False; model shadow=False; measured sample=False.
Model shadow is not a risk approval. FX-9 rechecks account, broker rules, costs, reservations and paper permissions. Actual IBKR fills remain unverified (FX-12).

checks.detail: Live mode and live explicit enablement must remain off.
An enabled USD-quoted CASH instrument with the selected long strategy is required; collection does not require trading enablement.
Other instruments must not be enabled for execution during the bounded pilot; collection may remain enabled.
FX research contract is missing, incomplete or inconsistent. No defaults were approved.
Reviewed venue base-unit minimum/maximum and evidence must be present and no older than 24 hours; broker rules still need a live refresh.
An existing operational database is required; this command never creates or migrates one.
Registry must already be PaperReady from FX-11 evidence; this command never changes it.
An unexpired FX-11 rollout assessment must retain PaperReady; its freshness limit is 60 seconds.
Exactly one approved FX model must match the current research contract and artifact hash.
Approved model must reference an intact completed FX evaluation and replay.
The isolated pilot requires no existing active local reservations; actual broker positions/orders require separate reconciliation.

PreflightAfterRepair.scope: Offline file/database preflight only; no broker connection, migration, approval or order submission.
